determinism.method: Every state this act changed was read back on the instrument that owns it, and every state it must NOT change was compared field by field against the step-1 read rather than eyeballed. The stop was gated on the runner's own exit, not a clock.
determinism.observed: State Running -> Disabled with Settings.Enabled false and the task still registered; arguments (412 chars), working_directory (64) and execute (38) byte-equal before and after; runner_processes 1 -> 0 of 720 with an any-python control of 50; STOP file present at 305 bytes and left in place; pins 5 of 5 locked; 3 ledgers closed and 0 sentinels at HEAD.

mutant.description: The order names no mutant. THREE negative arms stand in its place, and one of them caught a real defect in this seat's own instrument. (a) the process census carries an any-python positive control, so a zero cannot be a dead filter. (b) the loose token filter was re-run AFTER the probe was stopped, which is the control that proved the two it had been counting were its own. (c) the stop predicate was read out of the module (exists()-only, passed down to the backfill driver) instead of inferred from the file's name.
mutant.expected: the control reads non-zero where the target reads zero; the loose filter drops to 0 once the censor is gone; the predicate is existence, not content
mutant.observed: any-python 47-50 against runner 0; the loose filter read 2 with the waiter armed (both rows created at 18:22:29Z, the second it was armed) and 0 of 732 after it was stopped, while the real runner PID 37428 was already absent; stop_requested is bool(args.stop_file and Path(args.stop_file).exists()).

surprises: NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-S151: the order's premise that site Z stored new 0 for every publisher since the 14:02Z Python outage is FALSE for sa -- 'JOB sa ... status=new_articles stored=2' at 18:25:18Z and 'CYCLE sa ... asked 242 new 3' at 18:33:06Z. The live process started 07:47:40Z and kept the standard library it had loaded; the outage broke new LAUNCHES only. The retire stands on its own authority, but the sa baseline dell1 will be compared against is new 3 over 7 of 242 pairs, not zero.

NFRA_OPLGTW-Z-S152: this seat's own exit-waiter matched any command line containing the token cycle_runner, and its own bash wrapper carried that token, so the census included the censor -- floor 1, exit condition 0. Left armed it would have reported RUNNER-STILL-UP-AFTER-2H and obliged a FALSE ARMED row about a runner that had exited cleanly 100 minutes earlier. A census must exclude the censor.

declared_exclusions.item: the live scheduled task and the STOP file are not artifacts_produced rows
declared_exclusions.reason: Deliberate, and said here so it does not read as an omission. The checker resolves every artifact row against git except s3_object, ddb_rows and aws_resource, and a Windows scheduled task is none of those -- claiming one of those kinds to buy a skip would be a false kind. The task's state change and the STOP file are what AC1 grades directly (task state Disabled, STOP file present yes) and what EG3_PROOF.json records; they are acts read on their own instrument, not files this seat authored.

declared_exclusions.item: FIRSTREC (OG-eg-2) and WINDOW (OG-sa-1) are not proven, and are not claimed to be
declared_exclusions.reason: Both wanted evidence from a future site Z cycle: the first post-restart cycle record carrying s3_get_count/s3_get_bytes, and an SA bronze object newer than the re-registration for BA, BABA and COST. The runner is retired and site Z will not run another cycle, so neither can ever be produced here. Closed SUPERSEDED under the CTO's ruling with each leg recorded NOT-EXERCISED; this seat ran neither eg2.AC2.sh nor sa1.AC2.sh. The E1/E2 GET-bytes proof is owed on dell1 at pin 39ae28559b.

declared_exclusions.item: the exact instant the runner process exited
declared_exclusions.reason: Not recorded by any instrument on this box, so EG3_PROOF.json bounds it instead of inventing it: present at 18:13:30Z, last log line 18:33:06Z, absent at 18:53:36Z. stopped_at is set to the runner's own 'no further cycle' line, which is the moment it DECIDED to end, and the field says so rather than implying a measured exit.
